name: Crispy Toaster-Oven Chicken or Beef Flautas (Flour Tortilla)
whyItWorks: Rolling finely shredded chicken or ground beef inside a soft white flour tortilla and baking it gives a loud crunch without sharp corn chip hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Roll shredded rotisserie chicken (skin removed) and Monterey Jack inside a white flour tortilla, brush lightly with oil or butter, and bake in the toaster oven at 375F for 7-8 minutes. Dip in lactose-free sour cream or smooth avocado mash.
